questions.text: My share price went up {a}% and then fell {b}%. I started at {p}. Where am I now, and why isn't it back where it began?
questions.solution: {p} × {=1+a/100:2} × {=1-b/100:2} = {final:2}. Successive changes multiply, so a rise of {a}% followed by a fall of {b}% gives a factor of {=(1+a/100)*(1-b/100):4}, not 1 + ({a} − {b})/100.
